### Agree Realty Declares Monthly Common and Preferred Dividends


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/455732330/files/doc_news/Agree-Realty-Declares-Monthly-Common-and-Preferred-Dividends-2b1cc6ede-2026.pdf)


ROYAL OAK, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Agree Realty Corporation (NYSE: ADC) (the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized, and the Company has declared, a monthly cash dividend of $0.271 per common share. The monthly dividend reflects an annualized dividend amount of $3.252 per common share, representing a 3.4% increase over the annualized dividend amount of $3.144 per common share from the fourth quarter of 2025. The dividend is payable December 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 30, 2026.


Additionally, the Company’s Board of Directors has authorized, and the Company has declared, a monthly cash dividend on its 4.25% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock of $0.08854 per depositary share, which is equivalent to $1.0625 per annum. The dividend is payable December 1, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 20, 2026.


**About Agree Realty Corporation**


Agree Realty Corporation is a publicly traded real estate investment trust that is **RETHINKING RETAIL** through the acquisition and development of properties net leased to industry-leading, omni-channel retail tenants. As of September 30, 2026, the Company owned and operated a portfolio of 2,888 properties, located in all 50 states and the District of Columbia, comprised of approximately 61.1 million square feet of gross leasable area. The Company’s common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “ADC.” For additional information on the Company and **RETHINKING RETAIL** , please visit[www.agreerealty.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agreerealty.com%2F&esheet=54638235&newsitemid=20261110382541&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agreerealty.com&index=1&md5=f55a6810ff00f199af0d766eb6b906c0) .
